_comment: M0.9 (#33) committed review_rate baseline artifact. tests/golden/results/*.json is gitignored, so scripts/check_review_rate_gate.py and CI read this committed summary instead. Regenerate by running `lemely measure-accuracy` against a dev-split sweep and re-deriving these numbers with lemely.eval.analyses.review_rate over the saved eval_records. review_rate_signal/review_rate_total use the leaf-UNION numerator (a leaf counts as reviewed iff ANY of its raw fixture-variant records carries a qualifying trigger), not the single DA6-collapsed representative row.
